objects.taxonomy_description: A tall, long-necked ungulate with distinctive ossicones and a sloping back, distinguishable from other large herbivores by its extreme vertical proportions.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Neck_Length_Proportion: The neck is exceptionally long relative to the body, extending significantly higher than the shoulders.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Head_Appendages: The head features paired, skin-covered bony protrusions (ossicones) rather than branched antlers or hollow horns.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Back_Profile: The dorsal line slopes downward from the high withers to the lower hindquarters, creating a distinct incline.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Leg_Structure: The legs are extremely long and slender in proportion to the torso, supporting a towering overall stance.
